title: Behaviour test: the stdin-watchdog fallback never kills an owned Codex keeper still in the unfinished set, and the Linux sandbox is adopted by the keeper before teardown
outcome: Tests pin that the watchdog fallback routes an unfinished owned server to the keeper-safe end path, and that the Linux tree test covers a sandbox already re-parented to the keeper.
acceptance: A behaviour test registers an owned Codex server over a stand-in child that blocks on its input, ends it, makes the exit cascade fail, drives poll_shared_codex_stdin_watchdog, and shows the child still running and later exiting successfully when its input closes; it uses no timing thresholds.

On Linux, the delegation process-tree test waits until the sandbox's launcher has exited and the sandbox reports the keeper as its parent before it triggers completion or cancellation, and then shows the tree gone.
